selected_evidence.requirement: Create opsbot and key material on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the created account, key files, ownership, modes, and generated public key; it also records the unsupported directive validation error.

selected_evidence.requirement: Configure node2 for opsbot key-only access
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the locked account, authorized-key fingerprint, secure permissions, valid sshd configuration, and effective publickey-only policy.
Captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered sshd/account/key/policy state.
The initial baseline records node1’s boot ID and active sshd; subsequent direct attempts consistently show connection refused. No restart or recovery is claimed.
The matching key was generated on node1 and authorized on node2, but an actual SSH command from node1 could not be captured after node1 became unreachable.
